claims.text: Grain boundary engineering can optimize grain boundary characteristics in eutectic high-entropy alloys.
Optimizing grain boundary characteristics through grain boundary engineering will simultaneously increase strength and ductility in eutectic high-entropy alloys.
Grain boundary engineering enhances strength by reducing grain boundary sliding.
Grain boundary engineering increases ductility by promoting grain boundary-mediated plasticity.
The engineered alloy is expected to have greater strength than an otherwise comparable alloy without grain boundary engineering.
The engineered alloy is expected to have greater ductility than an otherwise comparable alloy without grain boundary engineering.
The intervention is expected to remain effective across operating conditions typical of structural applications.
